preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100000 for n in [int(stdin.split()[0])]) and all(1 <= m <= 100000 for m in [int(stdin.split()[1])]) and all(2 <= h <= 100000 for h in [int(stdin.split()[2])])
preconditions.description: Input constraints: n (number of data centers) is between 2 and 100,000, m (number of clients) is between 1 and 100,000, and h (day length in hours) is between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 3 and all(0 <= int(u) < h for u in map(int, stdin.split()[3:3+n]))
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n integers u1, u2, ..., un where each uj is a maintenance hour (0 ≤ uj < h) for data center j.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c1) <= n and 1 <= int(c2) <= n and int(c1) != int(c2) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:3+m] for c1, c2 in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each of the next m lines contains two distinct integers ci,1 and ci,2 (1 ≤ ci,1, ci,2 ≤ n) representing data centers for client i.

preconditions.expression: all((u1 != u2) for (c1, c2) in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:3+m]] for u1, u2 in [(int(u) for u in stdin.split()[3:3+n])[c1-1], (int(u) for u in stdin.split()[3:3+n])[c2-1]])
preconditions.description: The initial maintenance schedule ensures that for every client, the two data centers storing their data have different maintenance hours (u_{ci,1} ≠ u_{ci,2}).

postconditions.description: The first line of output is an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ n) representing the minimum number of data centers to shift.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1].split()) == int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[0]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: The second line contains exactly k distinct integers x1, x2, ..., xk (1 ≤ xi ≤ n) representing the indices of data centers to shift.

postconditions.expression: all((u1 != u2) for (c1, c2) in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:3+m]] for u1, u2 in [(int(u) + (1 if (i+1) in [int(x) for x in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1].split()] else 0)) % h for i, u in enumerate(stdin.split()[3:3+n])][c1-1], [(int(u) + (1 if (i+1) in [int(x) for x in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1].split()] else 0)) % h for i, u in enumerate(stdin.split()[3:3+n])][c2-1]])
postconditions.description: After shifting the maintenance hours of the selected data centers by one hour (with wrap-around if uj = h - 1), for every client, the two data centers storing their data must still have different maintenance hours.
